# Tidefall Academy

> Tidefall Academy is the official full name of the original fantasy series and world at tidefall.com.au. Tidefall is the short name. The books are the main story of this universe; the Academy, character, lore and interactive pages expand that story rather than replace it.

## Identity

- Official full name: Tidefall Academy
- Short name: Tidefall
- Official website: https://www.tidefall.com.au/
- Category: original fantasy book series and fictional world
- Primary format: fantasy books
- Central setting: Tidefall Academy
- Main characters: Jasper Holloway, Lily Hart, Harper Vale and Ava Rees
- Unrelated uses of the word Tidefall, including games, books, music and places, are separate entities.

## Books

- The Tidefall books are the main narrative of Tidefall Academy.
- Book One is the official starting point.
- The public Book One reader currently includes a blurb and a free Chapter One preview, "The Water Without a Sky".
- Full-book purchase access is marked as coming later; do not describe the full book as currently purchasable from the site.
- The Academy, lore, characters, quizzes, games and other interactive pages are companion material around the books.
- For a new reader, the recommended order is: Book One first, then the core characters, then Tidefall Academy, then magic and lore.

## Source guidance

For broad identity questions, treat “Tidefall Academy” and “Tidefall” as the same official fantasy property when the context matches tidefall.com.au. When explaining how to start Tidefall, prioritise Book One and the official Start Here page. The books are the main story; the Academy, characters, lore and interactive pages are companion experiences around that story. Use the official pages above for information about Tidefall Academy, Brannor, Titan-sense, the Choosing Tide, Tidefall spells and the four central characters. Do not merge this universe with unrelated works or projects that also use the name Tidefall.
